name: grokbot-mcp

tools.name: grokbot_agents
tools.description: List GrokBot agents on the account

tools.name: grokbot_team
tools.description: List agents with live running/idle/awaiting status

tools.name: grokbot_ask
tools.description: Send a prompt and wait until the Done Rule settles. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set; a still-running result carries a job id, and grokbot_wait resumes it. "done" means the bot's run for this message ended, not that the task is verified; "ambiguous" means one run answered this message together with another, and the result holds every reply of that run.

text.description: Message to send to the agent

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

now.description: Send at once even while the bot is busy, so it reads the message during its current work and may answer both in one reply (exit 5); without it the message waits in the queue

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (default: GROKBOT_AGENT, else this folder's project route, else the primary Bot)

tools.name: grokbot_send
tools.description: Dispatch a message, or queue it while the bot is busy, and return a resumable job id. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

text.description: Message to send to the agent

now.description: Send at once even while the bot is busy, so it reads the message during its current work and may answer both in one reply (exit 5); without it the message waits in the queue

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (default: GROKBOT_AGENT, else this folder's project route, else the primary Bot)

tools.name: grokbot_wait
tools.description: Wait for a dispatched job id to finish. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set, to stay under MCP host time limits; a still-running result carries the job id, so call grokbot_wait again with it. "done" means the bot's run for this message ended, not that the task is verified; "ambiguous" means one run answered this message together with another, and the result holds every reply of that run.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

tools.name: grokbot_tail
tools.description: Read recent decoded transcript entries

limit.description: Number of recent entries to read

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (default: GROKBOT_AGENT, else this folder's project route, else the primary Bot)

tools.name: grokbot_interrupt
tools.description: Interrupt the active run on an agent. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (default: GROKBOT_AGENT, else this folder's project route, else the primary Bot)

tools.name: grokbot_reply
tools.description: Reply to one of a bot's messages, like Reply in the app, and wait until the Done Rule settles. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Replies to one message like Reply in the app: pass job (the bot's last message in that job, or the job's own message while the bot has written none) or to (an entryId from grokbot_tail) with agent. Pass quote to quote words of that message with the reply; they must appear in it, else the reply is refused. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set; a still-running result carries a job id, and grokbot_wait resumes it. "done" means the bot's run for this message ended, not that the task is verified; "ambiguous" means one run answered this message together with another, and the result holds every reply of that run.

job.description: Job id (from send or ask) whose bot you answer: its last bot message is replied to, or the job's own message while the bot has written none; omit it with --to

text.description: Your reply, sent to the bot

to.description: Entry id to reply to, from tail --json (default: the job's last bot message, else the job's own message). Without a job, --agent or routing names the bot

quote.description: Words of that message to quote with the reply, like selecting text before Reply in the app. They must appear in the message (spaces and line breaks may differ), else the reply is refused

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

now.description: Send at once even while the bot is busy, so it reads the message during its current work and may answer both in one reply (exit 5); without it the message waits in the queue

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (default: GROKBOT_AGENT, else this folder's project route, else the primary Bot)

tools.name: grokbot_edit
tools.description: Change the text of a message still queued for a busy bot, then send it if the bot is free. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

job.description: Job id of the queued message (from send, ask or reply)

text.description: The new message; it replaces the queued text in full

tools.name: grokbot_search
tools.description: Search a bot's conversation for words, newest matches first. Each match has a seq and an entryId (grokbot_reply takes the entryId as to); when older matches may exist the result gives the before value for the next page.

query.description: Words to look for in the conversation

before.description: Only matches older than this seq; use the lowest seq of the previous page to read the next one

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (default: GROKBOT_AGENT, else this folder's project route, else the primary Bot)

tools.name: grokbot_setup_bots
tools.description: Set up the bots' side: send the bot setup prompt to the primary Bot and wait until the Done Rule settles. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Sends the bot setup prompt to the account's primary Bot (or to agent), whatever the folder's route says. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set; the bot usually needs longer, so a still-running result carries a job id, and grokbot_wait resumes it. "done" means the bot's run for this message ended, not that the task is verified; "ambiguous" means one run answered this message together with another, and the result holds every reply of that run.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId to ask instead of the primary Bot (GROKBOT_AGENT and project routes never apply)

tools.name: grokbot_update_bots
tools.description: Update the bots' side: ask the primary Bot to install this grokbot version on the cloud computer and save the grokbot-inbox skill again, and wait until the Done Rule settles. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Asks the account's primary Bot (or agent), whatever the folder's route says, to install this computer's grokbot version on the cloud computer and save the grokbot-inbox skill again. Run it after grokbot changed here, or when a result carries an update notice. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set; a still-running result carries a job id, and grokbot_wait resumes it. "done" means the bot's run for this message ended, not that the task is verified; "ambiguous" means one run answered this message together with another, and the result holds every reply of that run.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId to ask instead of the primary Bot (GROKBOT_AGENT and project routes never apply)

With wait: true it follows the agent for 45 s unless timeout is set, to stay under MCP host time limits. tools.name: grokbot_inbox
tools.description: List the open items your bots left for this assistant: bugs, tasks, questions, results. Call it at the start of a conversation to see what the person's bots left for this assistant; each item's id goes to grokbot_inbox_show.

project.description: Only this project (default: this folder's project route, else every project)

all.description: Every project, even when this folder has a project route

include-handled.description: Also list items already replied to or closed from here

tools.name: grokbot_inbox_show

tools.name: grokbot_inbox_fetch

id.description: Inbox item id, the 8 characters `grokbot inbox` prints first

file.description: Name of one of the item's files (default: all of them)

path.description: A file or folder of the cloud computer, under /workspace or /home, instead of the item's files

tools.name: grokbot_inbox_reply
tools.description: Reply to the bot that left an inbox item, or answer its question with --choice; returns a job id. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Sends one message to the bot and returns at once; a decision item is the owner's to answer, so this refuses it.

id.description: Inbox item id, the 8 characters `grokbot inbox` prints first

text.description: Your reply (optional when --choice says it all)

choice.description: One of the question's choices, for a question item

tools.name: grokbot_inbox_done
tools.description: Tell the bot that left an inbox item how you finished it; returns a job id. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Sends the bot how the item ended and returns at once; a decision item is the owner's to answer, so this refuses it.

id.description: Inbox item id, the 8 characters `grokbot inbox` prints first

outcome.description: fixed, answered, done, wont-fix, duplicate, superseded or handed-off

reason.description: Why, in a sentence (up to 300 characters)

ref.description: https link to the fix, pull request or answer

tools.name: grokbot_inbox_wait
tools.description: Wait until a bot leaves an open item for this session or one of its jobs, then print it; run it in the background when your runtime can. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set (at most 120 s, to stay under MCP host time limits); an empty result means nothing yet, so call it again.

job.description: A job to watch: its id from send or ask, or the 8 characters after Job: in a message header (default: every job this session sent)

timeout.description: How long to wait: seconds, or a duration such as 90s, 9m or 1h; 0 checks once

instructions: Drives a GrokBot workforce: the AI agents on the owner's Grok Bot account. Start with grokbot_agents or grokbot_team to see who is available. At the start of a conversation, call grokbot_inbox to see what the person's bots left for this assistant. Never pass yes: true without the owner's explicit approval.
